**The match is the 2026 FIFA World Cup Round of 16 fixture between the United States and Belgium, scheduled for July 6, 2026, at Lumen Field (Seattle Stadium) in Seattle, Washington, with an 8:00 p.m. ET / 5:00 p.m. PT kickoff.**[[1]](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/usa-belgium-live-stream-team-news-tickets-and-more)[[2]](https://www.starsandstripesfc.com/usmnt/44773/usa-vs-belgium-2026-world-cup-time-tv-schedule-streaming-and-lineups)

This analysis relies exclusively on information published or known before July 3, 2026 (primarily previews and profiles from ~June 28–July 2, 2026). All post-match details, results, or updates from July 3 onward are ignored. ### Head-to-Head History (Especially Major Tournaments)
- The teams first met at the 1930 World Cup, where the US won 3-0 in the group stage.[[3]](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/6/usa-vs-belgium-world-cup-last-16-balogun-trossard-prediction-kickoff)
- The US has lost all six subsequent meetings (a streak spanning nearly 100 years).[[1]](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/usa-belgium-live-stream-team-news-tickets-and-more)
- The most recent competitive encounter was the 2014 World Cup Round of 16 in Salvador, Brazil: Belgium won 2-1 after extra time (goals from Kevin De Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku), with US goalkeeper Tim Howard making a World Cup-record 16 saves.[[1]](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/usa-belgium-live-stream-team-news-tickets-and-more)
- Most recent meeting (pre-World Cup friendly, March 2026): Belgium won 5-2.[[3]](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/6/usa-vs-belgium-world-cup-last-16-balogun-trossard-prediction-kickoff)

### Recent Form and Results (Pre-July 3, 2026 Context)
- **Belgium**: Unbeaten since a March 20, 2025, 3-1 loss to Ukraine in UEFA Nations League play-offs (Rudi Garcia’s first match in charge). Record of 11 wins, 0 losses, 6 draws across 17 matches in World Cup qualifying, Nations League, and friendlies, with a +40 goal difference.[[4]](https://www.ussoccer.com/stories/2026/07/usmnt/opponent-profile-belgium-seattle-washington-world-cup-match-preview)
- **United States**: Strong momentum entering the knockout stage after advancing from the group stage and defeating Bosnia and Herzegovina 2-0 in the Round of 32 (July 1 or 2 window). Belgium had prior experience there in the group stage (1-1 draw with Egypt and another result).[[1]](https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/usa-belgium-live-stream-team-news-tickets-and-more)
- **Home/crowd advantage**: Significant for the US as co-hosts playing on home soil in a passionate venue; expected to be a major factor.[[8]](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/usa-belgium-world-cup-storylines-projected-lineup-predictions)
- **Travel/fatigue**: The US benefited from playing domestically with minimal long-haul travel. Belgium (European-based squad) faced transatlantic travel and potential accumulated fatigue from a longer extra-time group-stage exit (e.g., late goals vs. Senegal noted in previews).[[5]](https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/soccer/worldcup/2026/07/01/usa-belgium-world-cup-prediction-analysis-odds/90778238007/)
- Weather/pitch: Previews noted typical Seattle summer conditions (mild, possible sun); no major issues flagged for the natural or hybrid pitch at Lumen Field. ### Other Notable Storylines
- **Rivalry and redemption**: Framed as a revenge match for the US after the 2014 loss and recent friendly defeat, with Belgium’s “Golden Generation” remnants (De Bruyne, Lukaku, Courtois) still key.[[9]](https://www.tiktok.com/@bleacherreport/video/7658066343433882911)
- **Controversy**: Pre-match drama around Balogun’s red card and FIFA’s decision to overturn/suspend the ban, including reported lobbying.[[7]](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/06/nx-s1-5879131/2026-world-cup-fifa-usmnt-belgium-round-of-16)
- **Tactical notes**: Belgium often held possession advantages in prior meetings; previews highlighted the US needing to manage transitions against Belgium’s quality. US coach Mauricio Pochettino emphasized this as a signature win opportunity.[[8]](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/usa-belgium-world-cup-storylines-projected-lineup-predictions)

These factors (home venue and crowd, recent US momentum, Belgium’s long unbeaten run but potential fatigue, and historical rivalry) were the primary discussion points in pre-July 3 previews. Sources include FIFA.com previews, US Soccer opponent profiles, and betting/analysis outlets from early July 2026.

factors.impact: The US has lost all six subsequent meetings with Belgium over nearly 100 years, including the 2014 World Cup Round of 16 (2-1 AET) and a recent 5-2 friendly loss in March 2026. This long-standing trend and recent results strongly favor Belgium.

Belgium is unbeaten since March 2025, with a record of 11 wins and 6 draws across 17 matches (World Cup qualifying, Nations League, friendlies) and a formidable +40 goal difference. This indicates a high level of current performance and confidence.
As co-hosts, the US will benefit from playing on home soil at Lumen Field in Seattle, with significant crowd support expected to be a major factor.

Belgium, a European-based squad, faced transatlantic travel and is noted to have potential accumulated fatigue from a 'longer extra-time group-stage exit.' This contrasts with the US benefiting from minimal domestic travel.
The United States enters the match with strong momentum, having advanced from the group stage and defeated Bosnia and Herzegovina 2-0 in the Round of 32.
Pre-match drama saw Balogun's red card overturned/suspended, making a key US player available for the fixture.

analysis.reasoning: Belgium holds a significant advantage based on their historical head-to-head record, having won the last six encounters, including the crucial 2014 World Cup Round of 16 match and a dominant 5-2 friendly victory in March 2026. Their current form is also outstanding, marked by a 17-match unbeaten streak and a +40 goal difference since March 2025. These are strong, well-documented patterns suggesting Belgian superiority. However, the United States benefits substantially from playing on home soil in Seattle, with a passionate crowd expected. Critically, the notes highlight that Belgium faced transatlantic travel and potential accumulated fatigue from a 'longer extra-time group-stage exit,' which could be a significant mitigating factor. The US also carries positive momentum from advancing through the group stage and winning their Round of 32 fixture, coupled with the crucial availability of Balogun due to an overturned suspension. While Belgium remains the favored side due to their proven quality and history against the US, the substantial home advantage and potential fatigue impacting the Belgian squad warrant a conservative adjustment.
